SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO

CREATE PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList] AS BEGIN

			
WITH WMGLIST_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(WealthManagementGroupListSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimWealthManagementGroupList

)
,
TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList
AS (
SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM WMGLIST_SK) AS WealthManagementGroupListSK
, * from ( 
		SELECT
		 BWL.RM AS RM
		,BWL.ClusterName AS ClusterName
		,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
		,BWL.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
		,DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
		,BWL.CustomerID AS CustomerID
		,BWL.BusinessUnit AS BusinessUnit
		,1 AS CurrentIndicator
		,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
        ,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
		,BWL.SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
		FROM BNKM.WealthManagementGroupList BWL
		LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BWL.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID
		LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BWL.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID
		WHERE BWL.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'
        AND DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL
        AND DDC.CustomerSK IS NOT NULL
        ) A
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList FROM TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList;

WITH
TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	RM
	,ClusterName
	,AccountSK
	,AccountID
	,CustomerSK
	,CustomerID
	,BusinessUnit)) HASHROW, AccountID, CustomerID 
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	RM
	,ClusterName
	,AccountSK
	,AccountID
	,CustomerSK
	,CustomerID
	,BusinessUnit)) HASHROW, AccountID, CustomerID 
    FROM DW.DimWealthManagementGroupList  WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	    WHEN TGT.AccountID IS NULL AND TGT.CustomerID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
AND SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.AccountID IS NULL AND TGT.CustomerID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList_DELTA;



--------UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
    ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
    ,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimWealthManagementGroupList TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID  AND DELTA.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList SRC ON SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1;


INSERT INTO DW.DimWealthManagementGroupList (
	WealthManagementGroupListSK
	,RM
	,ClusterName
	,AccountSK
	,AccountID
	,CustomerSK
	,CustomerID
	,BusinessUnit
	,CurrentIndicator
	,ValidStartDate
	,ValidEndDate
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT
	WealthManagementGroupListSK
	,RM
	,ClusterName
	,AccountSK
	,SRC.AccountID
	,CustomerSK
	,SRC.CustomerID
	,BusinessUnit
	,CurrentIndicator
	,ValidStartDate
	,ValidEndDate
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimWealthManagementGroupList_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID  AND DELTA.CustomerID = SRC.CustomerID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
GO
